main.description: Top-level Request For Proposal (RFP). Envelope that strongRefs a domain-specific payload (e.g. compute.vm).

payload.description: Strong reference to the domain-specific payload record (for example a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.vm).

submitBid.description: Endpoint to send AT-URI and CID of bid to. Optional but bypasses need for bids to be seen in firehose since they are sent directly
